sections.section_title: TIM16/TIM17 DMA address for full transfer (TIMx_DMAR)(x = 16 to 17)
sections.text_helper: Section 57.8.20 "TIM16/TIM17 DMA address for full transfer (TIMx_DMAR)(x = 16 to 17)" in chapter 57 (General purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2924.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x3E0
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:0 DMAB[31:0]: DMA register for burst accesses
A read or write operation to the DMAR register accesses the register located at the address
(TIMx_CR1 address) + (DBA + DMA index) x 4
where TIMx_CR1 address is the address of the control register 1, DBA is the DMA base
address configured in TIMx_DCR register, DMA index is automatically controlled by the
DMA transfer, and ranges from 0 to DBL (DBL configured in TIMx_DCR).
